description: Renovate covers what the 'Sec :: Dep updater' workflow (uv lock --upgrade / pnpm re-resolve within declared ranges) cannot: updates outside the declared ranges for Python and JS, all updates for Go (go.mod has no ranges) and for external Helm charts.

packageRules.description: Python (pyproject.toml + uv.lock) and JS (pnpm workspace): only propose versions outside the declared range (majors, and 0.x minors past a tight cap such as torchvision<0.29 or ^0.4.7). In-range updates are left to the Dep updater.

Python deps capped at the next major ('>=X.Y.Z,<N'): 'bump' moves the floor to the new version and the cap to the next major ('>=1.77.0,<2' -> '>=3.51.0,<4'), keeping the convention the Dep updater relies on. Caps must be written '<N', not '<N.0.0' (Renovate keeps the cap precision, '<2.0.0' would become '<3.52.0'). Every minor/patch is in range there, so it is left to the Dep updater (bump would otherwise raise the floor on each one).
PyTorch CPU index versions carry a local label (2.15.0+cpu) that 'bump' cannot handle (no PR at all); 'replace' gives '>=3,<4'.
Test requirements.txt files are exact pins (==): majors only.
Go: go.mod pins exact versions, so Renovate handles minor/patch too. Tidy go.sum and rewrite import paths on /vN major bumps.
Go: one grouped PR for all minor/patch updates, majors stay separate.
Helm: track all versions of external charts.

customManagers.description: SeaweedFS Helm chart installed by Ansible (roles/app_edp/tasks/seaweedfs.yaml) with the version pinned in the EDP values file.
